observedFailure.error: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
observedFailure.path: WebSocket error callback calls close; close synchronously emits another error

boundedRegression.name: a synchronous error from WebSocket close cannot re-enter the error handler
boundedRegression.fix: Register the socket error handler once, so it is removed before close can re-enter it.

priorCiDisposition: Cancelled remaining owned jobs after reproducing the defect locally; completed jobs and logs retained
scope: Fixes reentrant socket error handling; the earlier Wrangler HTTP 500 probe failure has not been proven to have the same cause.
